import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
load=lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
a=load('audit.json'); fields=load('fields.json'); m=load('manifest.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['inputSha256']
def at(obj,p):
    for k in p.strip('/').split('/'):
        k=k.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
        obj=obj[int(k)] if isinstance(obj,list) else obj[k]
    return obj
ps=[f['pointer'] for f in fields]
assert len(a['reviewedPointers'])==len(set(a['reviewedPointers'])) and set(ps)==set(a['reviewedPointers'])
for f in fields: assert at(m,f['pointer'])==f['value']
inputs={'source':load('source.json'),'verification':load('verification.json'),'probe':load('probe-results.json')}
fs={f['id']:f for f in a['findings']}
assert len(fs)==len(a['findings'])
used=set(); edited=set()
for f in fs.values():
    assert any(e['file'] in ('source','probe') for e in f['evidence'])
    for e in f['evidence']:
        v=at(inputs[e['file']],e['pointer'])
        assert e['quote'] in v if 'quote' in e else e['value']==v
import re
for e in a['edits']:
    p=e['pointer']; assert p in ps and p not in edited; edited.add(p)

    for fid in e['findingIds']: assert fs[fid]['pointer']==p; used.add(fid)
    assert re.findall(r'\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}',at(m,p))==re.findall(r'\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}',e['value'])
assert used==set(fs)
print(f'Validated audit: {len(ps)} fields reviewed, {len(fs)} findings, {len(edited)} edits. Hash, evidence, links, and placeholders match.')

from pathlib import Path

    for k in p.split('/')[1:]:
        k=k.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')

    return obj
assert a['reviewedPointers']==[f['pointer'] for f in fields]
assert len(set(a['reviewedPointers']))==len(fields)
for f in fields: assert at(m,f['pointer'])==f['value']
inputs={k:load(v) for k,v in [('source','source.json'),('verification','verification.json'),('probe','probe-results.json')]}
findings={f['id']:f for f in a['findings']}
assert len(findings)==len(a['findings'])

    assert any(e['file'] in ('source','probe') for e in f['evidence'])
    for e in f['evidence']:
        v=at(inputs[e['file']],e['pointer'])
        assert e['quote'] in v if 'quote' in e else e['value']==v
seen=set(); linked=set()
for e in a['edits']:
    p=e['pointer']; assert p in a['reviewedPointers'] and p not in seen; seen.add(p)
    assert re.findall(r'\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}',at(m,p))==re.findall(r'\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}',e['value'])
    for fid in e['findingIds']:
        assert findings[fid]['pointer']==p; linked.add(fid)
assert linked==set(findings)
